name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2025-06-01, at wavelengths from 1.86 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
